method: 256 sampled tokens per layer; |x|<1%max fraction; dims needed for 99% L2 energy (down_proj output = sum swiglu_i * Wdown[:,i], so energy concentration bounds droppable dims)
verdict: MODERATE not extreme. No hard zeros; 99% energy needs ~37-57% of dims. Conditional MLP compute caps at ~2x MLP byte reduction, is dynamic per-token (gather/scatter cost), and 1% per-layer energy loss compounds over 62 layers (Doctor risk). A ~2x MLP win takes 15.4ms->~8-10ms => ~45 TPS: a real G20/G21 helper, NOT a dense path to 100 TPS.
consequence: 100 TPS critical path remains multi-token amortization (G12 self-speculative / G11 Matryoshka). Sparsity demoted to secondary G20/G21 lever, contingent on gather overhead and Doctor holding.
